description: This file defines a React functional component 'ThemesMenuButton' that renders a menu button for theme selection in a web application. It manages theme activation, handles premium feature restrictions, and displays corresponding icons and shortcuts.

classes.name: ThemesMenuButton
classes.description: A React functional component that provides a button interface for selecting and toggling themes, including support for premium features and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Handles the logic to activate or toggle the selected theme, showing a premium modal if the theme requires entitlement.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Event handler for click events that triggers theme toggling.
